findings.description: The vehicle presented as the same truck changes identity between sightings. At 00:00-00:10 it is a white/light semi tractor-trailer (separate trailer with visible gap behind the sleeper cab) parked flush against the diner's left side. At 01:44 the man exits the diner and walks to a dark green single-unit straight box truck (integral body mounted on the chassis, white stripe, chrome stacks and grille). Both color (white vs dark green) and configuration (tractor-trailer vs straight box truck) differ; no swap is shown on screen and no other vehicle implies a swap - the narrative treats it as the same truck. Overnight elapsed time alone does not explain a make/color/configuration change.
